Preliminary · 21 Sep 2026 · median + seed points

Kimonu Benchmark Figures

Five draft figures drawn from one verified data file. Stochastic arms show the median over seeds with each seed drawn as a point (n = 3); exact arms have no spread by construction. Starred arms exist for comparability, not as recommendations. Reference numbers are from the final rerun on the fixed algorithm and fixed LP bridge: sampled complete on 11 models × 3 seeds, exhaustive landed on 4 of 11.

Kimonu 33 · COCOA efficient=false 30 (all at 3 seeds) · efficient=true 31 (30 at 3 seeds) · reference exhaustive 4 of 11 landed (R stage on all 4) · reference sampled 11 × 3 seeds

F1

Balanced complexes

ready

Exact agreement with the reference on every landed cell, exhaustive and sampled (11 models). All arms present.

F2

Concordance modules

ready · reference exhaustive 4 of 11

Kimonu vs COCOA across 33 is ready. Reference exhaustive (final rerun) is identical to Kimonu, partition for partition, on each of the 4 landed models; the other 7 are running. Reference sampled is complete on 11 models × 3 seeds and is a strict subset of Kimonu's concordant pairs on every cell, never a superset, so its module count can land above or below Kimonu's (iIT341 178 vs 173, iLJ478 300 vs 267: dropped pairs split modules).

F3

Largest kinetic module

ready · reference on 4

Two Kimonu bars: the Upstream Algorithm (Remark S2-1) and, starred, the tentative four-phase version reproducing the reference's algorithm. Giants agree on 25 of 33; the reference's own R-stage giants (corrected NA subscript) on the 4 landed final models equal Kimonu's on each. COCOA efficient=false overshoots on iJN678 (1183 vs 551) in every seed, and on iIT341 / iHN637 in one seed of three.

F4

ACR and ACRR (free)

ready · reference on 4

Every reference ACRR pair is in Kimonu's set by name on all four landed models; the reference's criterion is the combinatorial sufficient condition, Kimonu's is the kernel test. The tall COCOA efficient=false bars on iIT341 and iHN637 come from a single seed whose concordance cascaded (ACRR 2089 and 2211 against 20–24 and 116 in the other two seeds); iJN678's 2484 is stable across seeds.

F5

Runtime

ready

Reference times are concordance only, from the fixed bridge. Sampled cells took 0.2–53 h each; five of them (iIT341 ×2, Saha ×3) ran their prefilter at a 4 GB cgroup cap and swapped, inflating that phase by minutes, not hours. Right panel: Kimonu's kinetic stage dominates on every model because its exact concordance is nearly free — the inverse of the reference, which spends ≈100% in concordance.

Source: benchmarks/figdata.json, drawn by benchmarks/figures/make_prelim.py. Provenance and trust per arm: the Pipeline Ledger.
